n0.text: Hold still, I'm measuring the squeak of your boots. Ah, this is the Mark IV Cheese-O-Matic. It slices, it dices, it occasionally explodes.

n1.text: I wired the windmill to the churn. Now it makes butter AND a pleasant humming noise. Mostly the humming.

gift.text: Oh! Take this spare gear. I made forty of them. Do not ask why.

no.text: Come back if your gadgets break. Or if they explode. Either is fine.
